doc.title: Cedar Walton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: NEA Jazz Master, family and the future
title: Banter: an album called 'Wow', big-band money and Blakey's Brinks truck
summary: Brower proposes a big-band album titled Wow and software orchestration; Walton jokes there is no big money in this art, quoting Blakey that no Brinks truck follows a hearse.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant
